messages:
Ivy: Heads-up: small-host p95 drift after kernel-selector tweak on canary. Dash: https://dash.redwood/hosts/tiny-p95 :eyes:
Noah: saw it. Any batching or kvcache signal?
Ivy: running_batch median fell 5->2, kvcache remote-rate +2.2%. Sample span below.
```
09:10:02.100 parse 0.8ms
09:10:02.101 tokenize 3.0ms
09:10:02.104 kvcache_lookup 0.6ms (miss -> remote 4.6ms)
09:10:02.110 kernel_exec 19.8ms
09:10:02.130 grpc_writev 4.2ms (3 frames)
```
Rae: sounds like selector picked the "vector-fuse" kernel for these shapes. It helps long seqs but hurts tiny reqs -> lower throughput -> smaller batches -> kvcache hot-shard contention -> remote fetches -> extra smallwrites. Feedback loop.
Noah: mitigation: infra-bot, please soft-rollback selector on canary. Also add a short-term gate: prefer scalar_light when running_batch_p50 < 3.
infra-bot: Soft-rollback requested. ETA ~60s.
replay-bot: Queued replay: replay/1735552468-2k-32t to reproduce. Link: https://replay.redwood/jobs/1735552468
Ivy: Follow-ups: RFC to add host_preproc + net cost into kernel scoring, emit per-host kernel_variant + running_batch hist + kvcache_remote_rate + grpc_smallwrite_count, and add the small-replay preflight to selector rollouts.
Noah: Also consider co-located tokenize sidecar experiment vs gRPC writev coalescing. We'll add both to replay matrix.
infra-bot: Soft-rollback complete. Metrics trending back.
Ivy: Closing alert, continuing work in RFC. Thanks :thumbsup:
